name: app-react-dashboard
description: Dashboard micro frontend for the Single-Spa architecture. This is the SECOND independently deployable React application in our setup, demonstrating how single-spa orchestrates MULTIPLE micro frontends on the same page. Like app-react-home, it exports single-spa lifecycle hooks and is loaded by the root-config shell via SystemJS. Having two micro frontends is the minimum needed to demonstrate multi-app orchestration — how single-spa decides which app to mount/unmount based on URL routing, how apps share the same DOM container, and how the lifecycle of one app is completely independent of the other.
